name: Hsü Hun
bio: Hsü Hun graduated at the government examinations in AD 832.
The poems here are Witter Bynner’s versions, from the texts of Kiang Kang-hu, in The Jade Mountain (1929).

poems.title: Inscribed in the Inn at T’ung Gate on an Autumn Trip to the Capital
poems.author: Hsü Hun
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
Red leaves are fluttering down the twilight
Past this arbour where I take my wine;
Cloud-rifts are blowing toward Great Flower Mountain,
And a shower is crossing the Middle Ridge.
I can see trees colouring a distant wall.
I can hear the river seeking the sea,
As I the Imperial City tomorrow —
But I dream of woodsmen and fishermen.

poems.title: Early Autumn
poems.author: Hsü Hun
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
